verdict.rationale: Bevy is a code-first engine with no editor UI. It is a normal Rust dependency whose engine and game logic all run through its ECS API, with full reference docs. The runtime probe confirms the cargo workflow "needs no editor for an agent to drive" and points to a first-party Bevy Remote Protocol, so the API is effectively the whole surface. Missing for 10: no first-party documentation of the Remote Protocol's coverage for driving a running app, and no independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven parity; parity holds only because no editor UI exists.
